# adopt best practices for mac, brew, mas

Apply the recommendations of Christopher Allen's [Brewfile tips gist](https://gist.github.com/ChristopherA/a579274536aab36ea9966f301ff14f3f) — declare taps explicitly, order and comment entries, use `brew bundle` for `mas` apps and casks as well as formulae, keep a `brew bundle cleanup` step — to the repository's Brewfile and `Apps` script.
